blocks.text: Egg Farms for Sale in BC

parts.t: More than 80 percent of BC's egg farms sit in Abbotsford and Chilliwack, which makes this the most locally concentrated farm sector in the province. Egg farming has its own quota mechanics that set it apart from chicken and turkey. If you’re buying or selling a layer operation in BC, these are the questions that matter most.

Even in a going-concern transaction, BC Egg determines whether the sale qualifies, and there are current rules around quota that’s surrendered or withheld in those transfers. Quota does not simply run with the land. Any transfer must be applied for by both parties and approved by the applicable marketing board, and it isn’t included in a sale unless expressly stated in the Contract of Purchase and Sale.
Can I buy an egg farm and get the quota with the land?

Not automatically. The land and the layer quota are treated separately — the quota moves under BC Egg’s rules, not simply by transferring title. Always confirm the quota amount, class, and transfer terms in the Contract of Purchase and Sale. Call
